## Appearance

Jerry has black hair and large black eyes. His facial features, specifically his eyes and hair color, are inherited from his father.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Jerry is a character defined by the deep adoration he holds for his father. His feelings toward his parent are strong enough to make him squirm with discomfort in certain situations.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P47](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0047)_

## History

Jerry Meredith is one of the motherless children of the new [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister, Mr. Meredith. Growing up at the manse, he forms a tight-knit friendship with the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children, frequently spending time with his siblings and neighbors sharing stories and trout in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). Alongside his siblings [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md), Jerry takes in a runaway girl named [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), giving her shelter in their garret before she is eventually adopted by Miss Cornelia. During a period when his father is away and his aunt is bedridden, Jerry helps his family manage the household, and later, he joins his siblings in forming the Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club) to police their own behavior and protect their father's public reputation.

As part of the [Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), Jerry takes an active role in enforcing discipline, forcibly pulling [Faith](../character/faith.md) off an ice bank when she tries to make herself sick, and later voting to punish her by forcing her to wear hated striped stockings. He also faces a gentle reprimand from his father alongside his siblings after they sing lighthearted songs in the graveyard during a prayer meeting, prompting the group to undertake a self-imposed fast. Following a scare where his siblings flee from a supposed ghost, Jerry decrees a punishment of cowardice for [Carl](../character/carl.md), sending him to sit in the graveyard until midnight; though [Carl](../character/carl.md) falls gravely ill with pneumonia as a result, he ultimately recovers. Jerry eventually joins the rest of the children in celebrating the upcoming double wedding of his father to [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. > "Of course it’s hard—but that’s the punishment of it. I could eat a graven image this very minute, but am I complaining? Let’s think of something else. We’ve just got to rise above our stomachs."
>
> — Jerry — [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P7](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0007)

> "is that Carl was the most to blame. He bolted first, as I understand it. Besides, he was a boy, so he should have stood his ground to protect you girls, whatever the danger was. You know that, Carl, don’t you?"

## Relationships

### [Carl](../character/carl.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carl--jerry.md)

[Carl](../character/carl.md) is Jerry's younger brother, raised alongside him at the manse. The two spend much of their time playing together with their siblings and the neighboring [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). They share in various local antics, such as taking in the runaway [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) and socializing in the local graveyard.

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--jerry.md)

Jerry is Faith's older brother. Together with their other siblings, they participate in daily adventures around [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), including exploring [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and sharing meals with the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) family. Along with the rest of the manse children, they help rescue and shelter [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) when she runs away.

### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jerry--john-meredith.md)

[John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) is Jerry's father, the local [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister. Because Mr. Meredith is frequently distracted by his theological studies and church work, Jerry and his siblings are largely left to raise themselves, which occasionally results in mischief and church gossip. Though his father struggles with discipline and parish pressure, he cares deeply for Jerry and his siblings.

- Child of — father (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026)</sub>
